messages:
kevin-docs: FYI I created a short PR to add a 'capacity-conversion checklist' for Dedicated migrations (v1 tenants -> reserved pools). Draft: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1410. Looking for quick engineering checks and a tiny terraform example.
tori-eng: Thanks — can you include the exact preemption behavior steps? We get a lot of questions: what happens to live requests when a tenant gets moved from shared to reserved pool?
kevin-docs: added a concise section: expected behavior, best-effort in-flight request completion, and when retries are recommended. Kept the wording non-normative per legal.
lucas-qa: small test matrix request: include a checklist for smoke tests (create tenant, set reserved_pool_ref, simulate load > cap, observe preemption logs). I can add commands.
kevin-docs: please add those commands. I put placeholders for logs and error codes.
anne-pm: add a one-line note about billing mapping: "reserved pools allocate committed capacity billed to pool owner" — don't use "charge" or hard guarantees.
eng-runtime-bot: compatibility notes: reserved_pool_ref moved from "pool_id" (v1) to a namespaced reference in v2; cooldown units changed from s -> ms; metrics aliases: RequestRate (preferred), QPS (legacy), RPS (alias supported). We will accept legacy aliases for one release.
tori-eng: terraform snippet looks helpful. Suggest we show both HCL and CLI examples for customers who use the provider vs platform CLI.
kevin-docs: added both. HCL sample:
```hcl
resource "redwood_reserved_pool" "east_commit" {
  name = "teams-east-commit"
  region = "us-east-1"
  capacity_gpu = 4
}
resource "redwood_scale_policy" "tenant_move" {
  name = "migrate-tenant-42"
  min_replicas = 1
  max_replicas = 6
  cooldown_ms = 180000
  metrics {
    type = "RequestRate"
    target = 300
  }
  reserved_pool_ref = "teams-east-commit"
}
```
lucas-qa: QA commands to simulate load added. Also included a check for the preemption log string: capacity_unavailable_preemption_possible.
eng-runtime-bot: note: when reserved_pool_ref is invalid we return 409 reserved_pool_conflict. Add that to the troubleshooting section.
kevin-docs: added error codes and a tiny RBAC checklist (service account needs reserved-pool get/list).
anne-pm: tiny UX suggestion: in the console we should surface a migration warning banner when a tenant references an unbound reserved pool. Filing a follow-up ticket.
devx-bot: Preview for PR 1410 deployed: https://deploys.redwood.com/preview/1410 (expires in 7 days).
kevin-docs: thanks everyone. I'll sweep the doc for microcopy and merge after eng-runtime final ack and devx CI green.
